ai_summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited reported strong 12% revenue growth in 1QFY27, but profitability significantly deteriorated with a 77% drop in PAT and EBITDA margins halving to 4.29%. This sharp decline was primarily driven by a disputed INR29 crore bill reduction on the AIIMS Jammu project, substantial uncompensated increases in labor and staff costs, and the absence of escalation clauses in many contracts. Management has consequently ruled out achieving double-digit EBITDA margins for FY27, highlighting ongoing risks from the arbitration process, unaddressed labor cost escalations, and potential unquantified impacts from future NGT measures.
